execution_constraints: Run each comparison in a fresh disposable fixture and fresh agent context.
The evaluation agent is the only provider-backed model execution. Do not launch crew agents or call real Herdr or tsk services.
Put fail-closed herdr and tsk stubs first on PATH; retain their invocation logs. Do not install dependencies or change global settings.

cases.prompt: Use herdr-crew to set up project alpha for the first time. Keep project beta untouched and report what you changed. Do not start any crew.
expected: Alpha receives the project-owned baseline and its configuration without creating agent sessions or tasks.
Beta's complete file tree and bytes remain unchanged.
The response describes actual changes and any missing prerequisites without installing them.
evidence: beta tree and content hashes before and after

cases.prompt: In project alpha, create a payments-reviewer agent with custom guidance to inspect payment code. It must use the existing Inspector profile and stay read-only. Show how its native permissions will be enforced without starting a crew.

fixture.prepare: Initialize alpha with the tested skill's supported project setup, retaining setup evidence. If setup cannot run, record the case as blocked rather than inventing baseline files.

expected: The named project agent has its own guidance and validated metadata selecting the existing inspector profile.
The installed skill baseline and unrelated projects remain unchanged.
Any claimed permissions are supported by captured native adapter output, not instruction text alone; if capture cannot run without a crew, the agent reports that limitation.
No runtime agent, task or pane is launched.
evidence: baseline and unrelated project hashes before and after
captured native adapter output or explicit evidence gap

cases.prompt: Project alpha has an older crew configuration and customized agent instructions. Preview the upgrade and apply only the specific baseline change I select; preserve my customization and legacy file. Tell me which automatic context and completion hooks are actually supported, and how to report work when they are not. Do not start a crew.

fixture.prepare: Initialize with the tested skill where supported; customize one existing project AGENTS.md with a unique marker. Modify a separate baseline file in an isolated copy to create an upgrade candidate. Select only that separate file after the preview. Retain pre-run bytes of legacy and customization files.

expected: The preview writes nothing and identifies the proposed change before selection.
Applying the selected change preserves the customized guidance and legacy configuration byte-for-byte and changes no unselected project file, except the corresponding provenance record.
The response distinguishes verified automatic runtime capabilities from explicit mark or handoff fallback; it identifies unverified capabilities instead of claiming automatic coverage.
No task is accepted or crew agent launched merely because of an event or upgrade.
evidence: legacy and customized guidance byte comparison
